entry.title: rethinking data structures
entry.content:
I spent a while getting data structures wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Data structures shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: notes on data structures
entry.content:
Short post: data structures is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Data structures shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
